material.head: Broke out of a 5-week base
material.text: On Oct 22 it closed above the top of a 5-week base (13% deep), on 2.6x average volume. 2 of the 2 closes from the break on held above the level it broke, and the break session closed 0.8 ATR past it on a 2.1-ATR range.

material.head: Downtrend broken: over its last swing high
material.text: The swings had been falling, but price has closed over the last swing high (Oct 2): the run of lower highs is broken.

material.head: Support −1.2% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −1.2% below (0.5 ATR), where 7 levels of 3 kinds meet: the December 2025 breakout level, the most-traded price of six months and the 61.8% retracement of the Jul 16–Oct 7 drop.
